responses.message: 15 min conference talk + 5 q&a. how many slides. its a uist paper, system + study

Typical sweet spot: **12–16 content slides** for 15 minutes, about a minute each, with a couple that go faster (title, transitions).

Rough budget for a system + study paper:
- 0:00–1:30 — motivating problem (1–2 slides, ideally one concrete student/user moment)
- 1:30–3:30 — what's missing in prior work (1–2)
- 3:30–8:00 — the system (4–5, mostly demo video/screenshots)
- 8:00–12:30 — study + key results (3–4, one figure each)
- 12:30–14:30 — implications/limitations (1–2)
- 14:30–15:00 — takeaway slide that stays up during Q&A

Rehearse to 13:30 so you have buffer. Session chairs cut you off.
the takeaway slide during q&a is a good idea
It does double duty — reminds the audience what to ask about and gives a good photo for anyone posting the talk. Put the paper title, one-line result, and a QR code to the paper.
